meta.name: api-test-suite-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to generate API tests, create integration test suites, test REST endpoints, or build contract tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成 API 测试套件，覆盖 REST 端点与契约测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为 REST API 快速创建集成测试或契约测试
copy.tagline_en: Generate API test suites automatically, covering REST endpoints and contract tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create integration or contract tests for REST APIs

howto.what: 它会扫描你项目里的 API 接口（支持 Next.js App Router、Express、FastAPI、Django REST 等框架），自动生成可运行的测试文件，覆盖认证、输入校验、错误状态码、分页、文件上传、限流等场景，输出为 Vitest+Supertest（Node）或 Pytest+httpx（Python）格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成 API 测试、创建集成测试套件、测试 REST 端点等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目的 API 都生成一套测试
say.note: 它会扫描路由并生成测试文件。

say.text: 为 Express 的 /users 接口写认证和输入校验测试
用 Pytest 给 FastAPI 端点做契约测试
say.note: 输出 Pytest+httpx 格式的测试。

howto.what_en: Scans API routes in Next.js App Router, Express, FastAPI, Django REST, and auto-generates runnable test suites covering auth, validation, error codes, pagination, uploads, rate limiting. Outputs Vitest+Supertest (Node) or Pytest+httpx (Python) test files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to generate API tests, create integration test suites, test REST endpoints, etc.

say_en.text: Generate a test suite for all APIs in this project.
say_en.note: It scans routes and produces test files.

say_en.text: Write auth and input validation tests for the /users endpoint in Express.
Use Pytest to build contract tests for the FastAPI endpoints.
